name: AFFALTER GT3

specs.notes: Mercedes-AMG's GT3 customer car (the Evo: 2020 on): the naturally aspirated 6,208 cc M159 V8 carried over from the SLS GT3, about 550 bhp with restrictors, a 1,285 kg homologated race weight (1,265 kg dry), a six-speed Hewland sequential transaxle (Motorsport Magazine's 2016 track test of the AMG GT3); its wheelbase 50 mm shorter than the SLS's 2,680 mm, so 2,630 mm, the road AMG GT's; 4,746 mm long, 2,049 mm wide (conceptcarz). The model's own tyres measure 680 mm front and 710 mm rear, 300 / 310 mm wide: GT3's 30/68-18 and 31/71-18. Torque, the rpm of the peaks, the limiter, the ratios, weight split (front-mid engine, rear transaxle: ~47 % front) and aero are estimates; the power is BoP-dependent.

garage.blurb: A GT3 car with a big naturally aspirated V8 sat behind the front axle and the gearbox at the back: heavy, stable, enormous traction, and a thunderous noise.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit (carbon tub, wheel with screen, seat, pedals): its racing wheel cut out by part; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.author: VTX (Sketchfab); the listing credits toddeppe
source.attribution: Mercedes-AMG GT3 Red Bull Racing by VTX (Sketchfab), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

limitations: Torque, the peaks' rpm, the limiter, top speed, the ratios, weight distribution and aero are estimates; the power and weight are BoP-dependent (SRO set 1,350 kg at one 2025 race).

Provenance: its materials are Unreal material instances named like Assetto Corsa Competizione's ('MI_Mercedes_AMG_GT3_Evo_...'): a game-asset port; fine among friends, replace before any public release.

Its sponsor livery is gone: the body is the game's paint (the garage's livery on it); the grille badge, the cabin and window stickers dropped. The three-pointed stars on the steering wheel, the boot lid and in the grille's texture stay (part of the model's mesh and textures, as the GLS's grille star is).
